# Duty Cleaners — Complete Site Reference

> Professional house cleaning services in Edmonton, Calgary, and surrounding Alberta communities. This document provides complete details about our services, pricing, coverage, and policies for LLM consumption.

## Company

Duty Cleaners is an Alberta house cleaning company, licensed and operating since 2017. We have cleaned 4,000+ Edmonton homes and 1,000+ Calgary homes. Our vetted cleaners are reference-checked and customer-rated. We use high quality, non-toxic cleaning supplies safe for children and pets.

- Edmonton phone: (780) 913-6565
- Calgary phone: (403) 768-1341
- Email: support@dutycleaners.ca
- Hours: Monday–Saturday 8:00 AM–8:00 PM, Sunday 9:00 AM–3:00 PM
- Website: https://dutycleaners.ca

## Services and Pricing

All pricing is transparent flat-rate by home size. Estimates are shaped by home size, service type, condition, and add-ons; if a home's condition requires more time than estimated, we explain why and review options with the customer.

### Standard Cleaning (from $155)

Routine maintenance cleaning for kitchens, bathrooms, bedrooms, and living areas: dusting, vacuuming, mopping, surface sanitizing, trash removal.

- 1 Bedroom: $155 · 2 Bedroom: $195 · 3 Bedroom: $232 · 4 Bedroom: $284 · 5+ Bedroom: $305
- Edmonton: https://dutycleaners.ca/edmonton/regular-cleaning
- Calgary: https://dutycleaners.ca/calgary/regular-cleaning

### Deep Cleaning (from $242)

Everything in Standard plus baseboards, vents, ceiling fans, light switches, door frames, appliance exteriors, and detailed attention to buildup.

- 1 Bedroom: $242 · 2 Bedroom: $300 · 3 Bedroom: $355 · 4 Bedroom: $424 · 5+ Bedroom: $463
- Edmonton: https://dutycleaners.ca/edmonton/deep-cleaning
- Calgary: https://dutycleaners.ca/calgary/deep-cleaning

### Move-In / Move-Out Cleaning (from $284)

Top-to-bottom cleaning for empty homes: inside cabinets and drawers, appliance interiors, closets, and full sanitization.

- 1 Bedroom: $284 · 2 Bedroom: $361 · 3 Bedroom: $414 · 4 Bedroom: $481 · 5+ Bedroom: $519
- Edmonton: https://dutycleaners.ca/edmonton/move-in-move-out-cleaning
- Calgary: https://dutycleaners.ca/calgary/move-in-move-out-cleaning

### Recurring Cleaning

Scheduled Standard Cleaning with frequency discounts: 20% off weekly, 15% off bi-weekly, 10% off monthly.

- Edmonton: https://dutycleaners.ca/edmonton/recurring-cleaning
- Calgary: https://dutycleaners.ca/calgary/recurring-cleaning

### Post-Construction Cleaning

Dust and debris removal after renovations or new builds: kitchens, bathrooms, surfaces, floors, and window tracks. Quoted by scope. Does not include inside vents or high exterior fixtures.

- Edmonton: https://dutycleaners.ca/edmonton/post-construction-cleaning
- Calgary: https://dutycleaners.ca/calgary/post-construction-cleaning

### Airbnb Cleaning

Short-term rental turnover cleaning with linen changes and restocking. Advance notice required for scheduling.

- Edmonton: https://dutycleaners.ca/edmonton/airbnb-cleaning
- Calgary: https://dutycleaners.ca/calgary/airbnb-cleaning

### Commercial Cleaning

Office and commercial cleaning: dusting, vacuuming, mopping, bathroom cleaning, breakroom cleaning, disinfecting touchpoints, and common areas. Recurring schedules available.

- Edmonton: https://dutycleaners.ca/commercial-cleaning
- Calgary: https://dutycleaners.ca/calgary/commercial-cleaning

### Wall Washing

Standalone wall washing service for stains, scuffs, and buildup.

- Edmonton: https://dutycleaners.ca/edmonton/wall-washing
- Calgary: https://dutycleaners.ca/calgary/wall-washing

## Policies

### Satisfaction Guarantee

If you are not satisfied, notify us within 24 hours after the cleaning with photos of the missed areas and we will return to re-clean those areas at no additional charge.

Details: https://dutycleaners.ca/satisfaction-guarantee

### Booking

Instant online quotes in about 60 seconds. Same-day and next-day availability in most areas. Water and electricity must be available at the home for cleaning.

Full room-by-room checklist: https://dutycleaners.ca/whats-included
